'''Koler''' was a [[Red supergiant/Legends|red supergiant]] located in the [[Koler system/Legends|Koler system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It was situated at the Deep Core's edge, near the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]].<ref name="Lessons" />
